Video Description Text Segments 1:
I had a teacher once who told me that I did not have to sit for hours at a time in order for meditation to be effective. Just one, two, three breaths. Can you find your attention for three simple breaths?

Can you give your attention to the breath as if your breath were God? Give your breath the attention that you might give if the Great Soul came and sat right next to you.

Feel every sensation as if it were speaking to you the great mysteries of the Universe.

Do not be afraid of the Silence. Just a few breaths.

Breathing in. Breathing out. There are no distractions. Everything that seems to be a distraction is just a reminder of who you really are; the One who observes the distractions; and deeper still, the One who forgives the distractions; and deeper still, the One who knows no distractions.
